• Can be replenished by Melee kills, respective Talents, and Weapon Blessings.
• It acts as a 'second' Toughness bar.
• This can exceed your Maximum Toughness.
live|veteran|duty-and-honour.advancedCn:
Voice of Command 现在还会为你和协同范围内的盟友提供：
• +50 韧性，持续 10 秒。

• 可通过近战击杀、相应天赋和武器祝福恢复。
• 其作用类似于第二条韧性条。
• 可超过你的最大韧性值。

live|veteran|overwatch.desc: Your Combat Ability gains +1 charge, but +33% Cooldown.
live|veteran|overwatch.advancedEn:
• +1 Combat Ability charge.
• +33% Cooldown.

• The Cooldown of the Second charge only starts after the First charge finished its Cooldown.
live|veteran|overwatch.advancedCn:
• +1 层战斗技能充能。
• +33% 冷却。

• 第二次充能的冷却仅在第一次充能完成后才开始。

live|veteran|close-order-drill.desc: Up to +33% Toughness Damage Reduction the more Allies in Coherency.
live|veteran|close-order-drill.advancedEn: • +11% Toughness Damage Reduction per Ally in Coherency. Stacks up to +33%
live|veteran|close-order-drill.advancedCn: • 协同范围内每名盟友提供 +11% 韧性伤害减免，最多叠加至 +33%。

live|veteran|precision-strikes.advancedEn: • +30% Weakspot Damage of Melee and Ranged attacks.
live|veteran|precision-strikes.advancedCn: • 近战和远程攻击的弱点伤害提高 +30%。

live|veteran|deadshot.desc: +25% Critical Chance & +60% Sway Reduction while using your Ranged Weapon's alternate fire, but lose 0.75 Stamina per second and an additional 0.1 per shot.
live|veteran|deadshot.advancedEn:
While Aiming with Stamina above 0 you gain:
• +25% Critical Chance,
• -+60% Weapon Sway,
• -19% Spread,
• -12% Recoil.
Aiming also drains Stamina:
• 0.75 per second,
• 0.1 per shot.

• This talent has no effect on Plasma Gun.
live|veteran|deadshot.advancedCn:
在耐力大于 0 时瞄准，获得：
• +25% 暴击几率，
• -+60% 武器晃动，
• -19% 散布，
• -12% 后坐力。
瞄准同时也会消耗耐力：
• 每秒 0.75，
• 每发 0.1。

• 此天赋对等离子枪无效。

live|veteran|bring-it-down.advancedEn:
• +20% Damage to Ogryns and Monstrosities.

• Does not buff Damage against Captains/Twins.
live|veteran|bring-it-down.advancedCn:
• 对欧格林和巨兽造成的伤害提高 +20%。

• 不会提高对队长/双子的伤害。

live|veteran|survivalist.desc: Replenish 1% Ammo for you and Allies in Coherency whenever any of you Kill an Elite or Specialist Enemy. This can only occur once every 5 s. This is an augmented version of Scavenger .
live|veteran|survivalist.descCn:
• 当你或协同范围内的盟友击杀精英或专家敌人时，为你和盟友补充 1% 弹药。每 5 秒最多触发一次。
• 此为 Scavenger 的增强版本。

• 不会与其他老兵的相同光环叠加。
live|veteran|survivalist.advancedEn:
• 1% Ammo replenishes for you and Allies in Coherency whenever any of you Kill an Elite or Specialist Enemy. This can occur once every 5 seconds.
• This is an augmented version of Scavenger.

• Does not Stack with the same Aura from another Veteran.
live|veteran|survivalist.advancedCn:
• 当你或协同范围内的盟友击杀精英或专家敌人时，为你和盟友补充 1% 弹药。每 5 秒最多触发一次。
• 此为 Scavenger 的增强版本。

• 不会与其他老兵的相同光环叠加。

live|veteran|shredder-frag-grenade.desc: Throw a frag grenade that explodes after a short delay. Applies 6 Stacks of Bleed to all Enemies Hit, causing Damage over time. This is an augmented version of Frag Grenade .
live|veteran|shredder-frag-grenade.advancedEn:
Throw a Frag Grenade that explodes after 1.7 seconds. Applies 6 Stacks of Bleed to all Enemies Hit, causing Damage over time.
• This is an augmented version of Frag Grenade.

• Base Damage: [500-200].

• Deals high Stagger against all enemies including Monstrosities.
• Max explosion radius: 10 meters.
• Up to 16 Max Bleed Stacks.
live|veteran|shredder-frag-grenade.advancedCn:
投掷破片手雷，1.7 秒后爆炸。对所有命中敌人施加 6 层流血，造成持续伤害。
• 此为 Frag Grenade 的增强版本。

• 基础伤害：[500-200]。

• 对所有敌人（包括巨兽）造成强力踉跄。
• 最大爆炸半径：10 米。
• 最多 16 层流血。

live|veteran|fully-loaded.advancedEn:
• +25% Maximum Ammo in reserve.

• Rounds down.
live|veteran|fully-loaded.advancedCn:
• +25% 备用弹药上限。

• 向下取整。

live|veteran|duck-and-dive.desc: +30% Stamina on avoiding Ranged Attacks by Dodging, Sprinting or Sliding.
live|veteran|duck-and-dive.advancedEn:
• +30% of Max Stamina on avoiding Ranged Attacks by Dodging, Sprinting or Sliding.

• Requires more than 0 Stamina.
• Has an internal Cooldown of 3 seconds.
live|veteran|duck-and-dive.advancedCn:
• 通过闪避、冲刺或滑铲躲避远程攻击时，恢复 +30% 最大耐力。

• 需要耐力大于 0。
• 内置冷却 3 秒。

live|veteran|iron-will.desc: +50% Reduced Toughness Damage if above 75% Toughness.
live|veteran|iron-will.descCn: • 当韧性高于 75% 时，获得 +50% 韧性伤害减免。
live|veteran|iron-will.advancedEn: • +50% Toughness Damage Reduction if above 75% Toughness.
live|veteran|iron-will.advancedCn: • 当韧性高于 75% 时，获得 +50% 韧性伤害减免。

live|veteran|close-quarters-killzone.desc: +15% Close Damage for 10 s on Combat Ability use. When using Infiltrate , this begins on leaving Stealth.
live|veteran|close-quarters-killzone.advancedEn:
• +15% Damage for 10 seconds to enemies within 12.5 meters on Combat Ability use.
Beyond 12.5 meters, the Damage buff decreases linearly until it loses its effect at 30 meters:
_______________________________
Distance (m) 1 | 12.5 | 15 | 20 | 25 | 30
Damage(%): 15 | 15 | ~13 | ~9 | ~4 | 0
_______________________________
• This also increases the Damage of explosions and DoTs as long as Veteran stays within 30 meters to the enemy.

• When using Infiltrate, this begins on leaving Stealth.
live|veteran|close-quarters-killzone.advancedCn:
• 使用战斗技能后，对 12.5 米内的敌人造成的伤害提高 +15%，持续 10 秒。
超过 12.5 米后，伤害加成线性递减，至 30 米时完全失效：
_______________________________
距离(m): 1 | 12.5 | 15 | 20 | 25 | 30
伤害（%）: 15 | 15 | ~13 | ~9 | ~4 | 0
_______________________________
• 这也提高爆炸和持续伤害，只要老兵与敌人的距离在 30 米内。

• 使用 Infiltrate 时，此效果在离开隐身后开始生效。

live|veteran|marksman.desc: On Ability use, for 10 s any Weakspot hits gain +20% Strength. When using Infiltrate , this is applied after leaving Stealth.
live|veteran|marksman.descCn:
使用战斗技能后，+20% 威力加成于弱点命中，持续 10 秒。

• 当使用 Infiltrate 时，此效果在离开隐身后生效。
live|veteran|marksman.advancedEn:
+20% Strength to Weakspot Hits for 10 seconds on Combat Ability use.

• When using Infiltrate, this is applied after leaving Stealth.
live|veteran|marksman.advancedCn:
使用战斗技能后，+20% 威力加成于弱点命中，持续 10 秒。

• 当使用 Infiltrate 时，此效果在离开隐身后生效。

live|veteran|long-range-assassin.desc: Increase Maximum stacks of Focus from 10 to 15 .
live|veteran|long-range-assassin.advancedEn: • +5 Maximum Focus Stacks. Increases from 10 to 15.
live|veteran|long-range-assassin.advancedCn: • +5 最大专注层数。从 10 提高至 15。

live|veteran|on-your-toes.desc: Activating Melee Specialist and Ranged Specialist replenishes 20% Toughness. 3 s Cooldown for each.
live|veteran|on-your-toes.descCn:
激活近战专家或远程专家时恢复：
• 20% 韧性。
• 每种效果冷却 3 秒。
live|veteran|on-your-toes.advancedEn:
Activating Melee Specialist or Ranged Specialist replenishes:
• 20% Toughness.
• Cooldown: 3 seconds each.
live|veteran|on-your-toes.advancedCn:
激活近战专家或远程专家时恢复：
• 20% 韧性。
• 每种效果冷却 3 秒。

live|veteran|always-prepared.desc: Activating Ranged Specialist replenishes up to 3.3% of your missing ammo in your Clip from your Reserve, rounded up, for each stack.
live|veteran|always-prepared.advancedEn:
On activation, Ranged Specialist restores from Reserves per Stack:
• 3.3% of your missing Clip ammo, up to 33%
• Rounded up.
live|veteran|always-prepared.advancedCn:
激活远程专家时，每层从备弹中装填缺失弹药的 3.3%，最多 33%。
• 向上取整。

live|veteran|target-down.desc: If an Enemy you have Tagged dies, replenish 5% Toughness and 5% Stamina for each stack of Focus Target applied, to you and Allies in Coherency.
live|veteran|target-down.advancedEn:
When an enemy tagged with Focus Target dies, you and Allies in Coherency restore per Stack:
• 5% Toughness and
• 5% Stamina.
live|veteran|target-down.advancedCn:
当被锁定目标标记的敌人死亡时，你和协同范围内的盟友每层恢复：
• 5% 韧性和
• 5% 耐力。

live|veteran|redirect-fire.desc: If an Enemy you have Tagged dies, grant +2.5% Damage for each stack of Focus Target applied, to you and Allies in Coherency. Lasts 10 s.
live|veteran|redirect-fire.advancedEn:
When an enemy tagged with Focus Target dies, you and Allies in Coherency gain per Stack:
• +2.5% Damage.
• Lasts 10 seconds.
live|veteran|redirect-fire.advancedCn:
当被锁定目标标记的敌人死亡时，你和协同范围内的盟友每层获得：
• +2.5% 伤害。
• 持续 10 秒。

live|veteran|focussed-fire.desc: Focus Target Max Stacks increased to 6 .
live|veteran|focussed-fire.advancedEn: • +2 Maximum Focus Target Stacks. Increases from 4 to 6.
live|veteran|focussed-fire.advancedCn: • +2 最大锁定目标层数。从 4 提高至 6。

live|zealot|blood-redemption.descCn: • +100% 近战击杀时韧性 恢复。
live|zealot|blood-redemption.advancedCn: • +100% 近战击杀时韧性 恢复。

live|zealot|scourge.desc: Melee Critical Hits apply Bleed, causing Damage over time. Melee Hits on Bleeding Enemies grant +10% Critical Chance for 3 s. Stacks 3 times.
live|zealot|scourge.advancedEn:
Melee Critical Hits apply Bleed, causing Damage over time. Up to 16 Max Bleed Stacks on a target.

Melee Hits on Bleeding Enemies grant for 3 seconds:
• +10% Critical Chance.
• Stacks 3 times.
live|zealot|scourge.advancedCn:
近战暴击 施加流血，造成持续伤害。每个目标最多 16 层。

近战命中流血中 敌人时 3 秒内获得：
• +10% 暴击几率。
• 最多 3 层。

live|zealot|backstabber.desc: +25% Damage on Backstab and Flanking Hits.
live|zealot|backstabber.advancedEn: • +25% Damage on Backstab and Flanking Hits.

live|zealot|disdain.desc: +5% Damage on your next Melee Attack for each Enemy Hit. Stacks 5 times.
live|zealot|disdain.advancedEn:
• +5% Damage for every Second Melee Attack you make for each enemy Hit by your previous Melee Attack.
• Stacks 5 times.
live|zealot|disdain.advancedCn:
• 每次第二次近战攻击，每命中一个前一次攻击击中的敌人 +5% 伤害。
• 最多 5 层。

live|zealot|purge-the-unclean.desc: +20% Increased Damage against Infested & Unyielding Enemies.
live|zealot|purge-the-unclean.descCn: • +20% 对被感染和不屈敌人的伤害。
live|zealot|purge-the-unclean.advancedEn: • +20% Damage against Infested and Unyielding Enemies.
live|zealot|purge-the-unclean.advancedCn: • +20% 对被感染和不屈敌人的伤害。

live|zealot|anoint-in-blood.desc: Up to +25% Base Ranged Damage, reduced the further you are from the target.
live|zealot|anoint-in-blood.descCn: 最多 +25% 基础远程伤害，距目标越远则减少。
live|zealot|anoint-in-blood.advancedEn: Up to +25% Base Ranged Damage, reduced the further you are from the target.
live|zealot|anoint-in-blood.advancedCn: 最多 +25% 基础远程伤害，距目标越远则减少。

live|zealot|immolation-grenade.desc: Throw a grenade that leaves a layer of flaming liquid, Burning and Staggering enemies, and barring their path. Most effective against Unarmoured Enemies.
live|zealot|immolation-grenade.advancedEn:
Throw a grenade that explodes after 1.7 seconds. It leaves a layer of flaming liquid that Burning and Staggering enemies, and barring their path.
• Lasts 15 seconds.
• Replenishes all grenades per grenade pickup.

• Can be applied through shields.
live|zealot|immolation-grenade.advancedCn:
投掷手雷，1.7 秒后爆炸，留下燃烧液体层，阻断敌人通路，并造成燃烧中 和踉跄。
• 持续 15 秒。
• 拾取手雷时补充全部。

• 可以穿过护盾应用。

live|zealot|blades-of-faith.desc: Throw a consecrated knife to deal high Damage to a Single Enemy. Very effective against most Enemies; less effective versus Carapace Armour. - Quick Throw - Killing Elite & Special Enemies in Melee replenishes 1 knife - Ammo boxes replenish knives
live|zealot|blades-of-faith.advancedEn:
Quickly throw a consecrated knife to deal High Damage to a Single Enemy.

• Base Damage: 585.
• Can Cleave 1 Groaner, Poxwalker, Scab/Dreg Stalker or Scab Shooter.
• Deals no Damage vs Carapace except on Weakspots.

• Knives replenish:
• +1 - Elite or Specialist Melee kill.
• +2 - Small ammo pickup.
• +6 - Large ammo pickup.
• Full refill - Ammo crate.
live|zealot|blades-of-faith.advancedCn:
快速投掷圣化匕首，对单一敌人造成高伤害。

• 基础伤害：585。
• 可顺劈 1 个呻吟者、瘟疫行者、潜行者或射手。
• 对甲壳护甲无伤害，弱点 除外。

• 匕首补充：
• +1 - 近战击杀精英或专家。
• +2 - 拾取小型弹药包。
• +6 - 拾取大型弹药包。
• 全部 - 弹药箱。

live|zealot|second-wind.desc: Replenish 15% Toughness on a Successful Dodge.
live|zealot|second-wind.descCn: • 15% 韧性 成功闪避时恢复。
live|zealot|second-wind.advancedEn: • 15% Toughness replenished on a Successful Dodge.
live|zealot|second-wind.advancedCn: • 15% 韧性 成功闪避时恢复。

live|zealot|the-voice-of-terra.descCn: • 4% 韧性 在远程击杀时恢复。
live|zealot|the-voice-of-terra.advancedCn: • 4% 韧性 在远程击杀时恢复。

live|zealot|restoring-faith.desc: On taking Damage, heal 20% of that Damage. Occurs over 4 s.
live|zealot|restoring-faith.descCn: 受到生命 伤害 时，4 秒内治愈 20% 该伤害。
live|zealot|restoring-faith.advancedEn:
On taking Health Damage, heal 20% of that Damage.
• Occurs over 4 seconds.
live|zealot|restoring-faith.advancedCn: 受到生命 伤害 时，4 秒内治愈 20% 该伤害。

live|zealot|bleed-for-the-emperor.desc: Damage that would take your Health to the next Wound is reduced by 40% .
live|zealot|bleed-for-the-emperor.descCn: • - 40% 将你生命 减至下一个伤痕 的伤害。
live|zealot|bleed-for-the-emperor.advancedEn: • -40% Damage that would take your Health to the next Wound.
live|zealot|bleed-for-the-emperor.advancedCn: • - 40% 将你生命 减至下一个伤痕 的伤害。

live|zealot|vicious-offering.desc: Replenish 10% Toughness on Heavy Attack Kill.
live|zealot|vicious-offering.descCn: • 10% 韧性 重攻击杀时恢复。
live|zealot|vicious-offering.advancedEn: • 10% Toughness replenished on Heavy Attack Kill.
live|zealot|vicious-offering.advancedCn: • 10% 韧性 重攻击杀时恢复。

live|zealot|dance-of-death.desc: -75% Spread and -50% Recoil for 3 s on successful Dodge.
live|zealot|dance-of-death.descCn:
成功闪避后 3 秒内获得：
• -75% 散布 和
• -50% 后坐力。
live|zealot|dance-of-death.advancedEn:
On successful Dodge you gain for 3 seconds:
• -75% Spread and
• -50% Recoil.
live|zealot|dance-of-death.advancedCn:
成功闪避后 3 秒内获得：
• -75% 散布 和
• -50% 后坐力。

live|zealot|benediction.desc: +15% Toughness Damage Reduction for you and Allies in Coherency. This is an augmented version of the base Aura, The Emperor's Will .
live|zealot|benediction.descCn:
• +15% 韧性伤害减免 对你和协同 盟友。
• 为基础光环 The Emperor's Will 的增强版本。

• 不会与其他狂信徒的相同光环叠加。
live|zealot|benediction.advancedEn:
• +15% Toughness Damage Reduction for you and Allies in Coherency.
• This is an augmented version of the base Aura, The Emperor's Will.

• Does not Stack with the same Aura from another Zealot.
live|zealot|benediction.advancedCn:
• +15% 韧性伤害减免 对你和协同 盟友。
• 为基础光环 The Emperor's Will 的增强版本。

• 不会与其他狂信徒的相同光环叠加。

live|zealot|duellist.desc: +50% Finesse Damage for 3 s on successful Dodge.
live|zealot|duellist.descCn: • 成功闪避后 3 秒内，+50% 灵巧伤害。
live|zealot|duellist.advancedEn: • +50% Finesse Damage for 3 seconds on successful Dodge.
live|zealot|duellist.advancedCn: • 成功闪避后 3 秒内，+50% 灵巧伤害。

live|zealot|shield-of-contempt.desc: When you or an Ally in Coherency takes damage, they gain +60% Damage Reduction for 4 s. Triggers every 8 s.
live|zealot|shield-of-contempt.descCn:
你或协同 盟友受到生命 伤害 时，4 秒内获得：
• +60% 伤害抗性。

• 每 8 秒触发一次。
live|zealot|shield-of-contempt.advancedEn:
When you or an Ally in Coherency takes Health Damage, they gain for 4 seconds:
• +60% Damage Reduction.

• Triggers every 8 seconds.
live|zealot|shield-of-contempt.advancedCn:
你或协同 盟友受到生命 伤害 时，4 秒内获得：
• +60% 伤害抗性。

• 每 8 秒触发一次。

live|zealot|fury-of-the-faithful.desc: Dash forward, Replenishing 50% Toughness & gaining +20% Attack Speed for 10 s. Your next Melee Hit gains +25% Damage, has +100% Rending, and is a guaranteed Critical Hit. Base Cooldown: 30 s This is an augmented version of Chastise the Wicked .
live|zealot|fury-of-the-faithful.advancedEn:
Dash forward and replenish:
• 50% Toughness.
Also gain:
• +20% Attack Speed for 10 seconds.

Your next Melee Hit is a guaranteed Critical Hit and gains:
• +25% Damage,
• 100% Rending.

• Base Cooldown: 30 seconds.
• This is an augmented version of Chastise the Wicked.

• Grants immunity to Toughness Damage and you Dodge all attacks while dashing.

• Dash Range:
• Base: 7 meters.
• Aimed: up to 21 meters.
• You can't change direction, but you can cancel the dash with Block or Back buttons.
• Cannot be activated while jumping or falling.
• You can be stopped by Unyielding, Carapace, Monstrosities, as well as the Void shields.
live|zealot|fury-of-the-faithful.advancedCn:
向前冲刺并恢复：
• 50% 韧性。
另获得：
• +20% 攻击速度，持续 10 秒。

下一次近战命中必定造成致命一击 且获得：
• +25% 伤害 和
• 100% 撕裂。

• 基础冷却：30 秒。
• 为 Chastise the Wicked 的强化版本。

• 冲刺期间免疫韧性 伤害 并闪避所有攻击。

• 冲刺距离：
• 基础：7 公尺。
• 瞄准：最远 21 公尺。
• 你无法改变方向，但可以用格挡或后退按键取消冲刺。
• 跳跃或坠落时无法启用。
• 不屈敌人、甲壳护甲敌人、巨兽与虚空护盾都能阻止你。

live|zealot|until-death.desc: Fatal Damage instead grants you Invulnerability for 5 s. Occurs every 120 s.
live|zealot|until-death.descCn:
致命伤害 改为赋予你 5 秒无敌状态。
• 每 120 秒触发一次。
live|zealot|until-death.advancedEn:
Fatal Damage instead grants you Invulnerability for 5 seconds.
• Occurs every 120 seconds.
live|zealot|until-death.advancedCn:
致命伤害 改为赋予你 5 秒无敌状态。
• 每 120 秒触发一次。

live|zealot|punishment.desc: Melee Attacks that Hit at least 2 Enemies grant +8% Impact Strength for 8 s. Stacks 5 times. At max Stacks gain Uninterruptible.
live|zealot|punishment.descCn:

live|zealot|impassible.desc: Gain +50% Block Cost Reduction while Dodging and for 2 s afterwards. Perfect Blocking an attack restores 3 Dodges. 8 s Internal Cooldown.
live|zealot|impassible.descCn:
闪避期间和后续 2 秒内获得：
• +50% 格挡消耗减少。
• 内部冷却：8 秒。

• 完美格挡攻击恢复 3 次闪避。
live|zealot|impassible.advancedEn:
While Dodging and for 2 seconds afterwards you gain:
• +50% Block Cost Reduction.
• Internal Cooldown: 8 seconds.

• Perfect Blocking an Attack restores 3 Dodges.
live|zealot|impassible.advancedCn:
闪避期间和后续 2 秒内获得：
• +50% 格挡消耗减少。
• 内部冷却：8 秒。

• 完美格挡攻击恢复 3 次闪避。

live|zealot|out-of-pocket.desc: Melee Backstab Kills replenish +5% of your Missing Ammo from your Reserve when swapping to your Ranged Weapon. Stacks 5 times.
live|zealot|out-of-pocket.descCn:
近战背刺击杀将备用弹药补充 +5% 缺少的弹药，切换远程武器时触发。
• 最多 5 层。
live|zealot|out-of-pocket.advancedEn:
Melee Backstab Kills replenish +5% of your Missing Ammo from your Reserve when swapping to your Ranged Weapon.
• Stacks 5 times.
live|zealot|out-of-pocket.advancedCn:
近战背刺击杀将备用弹药补充 +5% 缺少的弹药，切换远程武器时触发。
• 最多 5 层。

live|zealot|on-the-brink.desc: Martyrdom grants +10% Corruption Resistance per stack.
live|zealot|on-the-brink.descCn: • 每层 Martyrdom +10% 腐败 抗性。
live|zealot|on-the-brink.advancedEn: • +10% Corruption Resistance per Stack of Martyrdom.
live|zealot|on-the-brink.advancedCn: • 每层 Martyrdom +10% 腐败 抗性。

live|zealot|time-to-kill.descCn:
• +50% 近战背刺伤害。
• 冷却：8 秒。
live|zealot|time-to-kill.advancedCn:
• +50% 近战背刺伤害。
• 冷却：8 秒。

live|zealot|against-the-odds.desc: For every 2 enemies within 5 m, gain +2% Damage and +10% Cleave. Stacks 5 times.
live|zealot|against-the-odds.descCn:
每 2 个在 5 米内的敌人获得：
• +2% 伤害 和
• +10% 顺劈攻击。
• 最多 5 层。
live|zealot|against-the-odds.advancedEn:
For every 2 enemies within 5 meters, gain:
• +2% Damage and
• +10% Cleave.
• Stacks 5 times.
live|zealot|against-the-odds.advancedCn:
每 2 个在 5 米内的敌人获得：
• +2% 伤害 和
• +10% 顺劈攻击。
• 最多 5 层。

live|psyker|soulstealer.desc: Replenish 7.5% Toughness on Warp Attack Kill.
live|psyker|soulstealer.descCn: • 以亚空间攻击击杀敌人时，恢复7.5%.韧性。
live|psyker|soulstealer.advancedEn: • 7.5% Toughness replenishes on Warp Attack Kill.
live|psyker|soulstealer.advancedCn: • 以亚空间攻击击杀敌人时，恢复7.5%.韧性。

live|psyker|mettle.desc: Critical Hits replenish 10% Toughness over 4 s. Critical Hits also grant +5% Movement Speed for 4 s, stacking 3 times.
live|psyker|mettle.advancedEn:
• 2.5% Toughness restored per second on Critical Hits, up to 10% Toughness over 4 seconds.
• Can be refreshed during active duration.

• +5% Movement Speed for 4 seconds on Critical Hits.
• Stacks 3 times.
• Can generate multiple Stacks per Critical Attack when Cleaving.
• Can be refreshed during active duration.
live|psyker|mettle.advancedCn:
• 暴击命中时，每秒恢复2.5% 韧性，在4秒内最多恢复10%韧性。
• 可以在激活期间刷新。

• 暴击命中时，获得+5%移动速度，持续4秒。
• 叠加3次。
• 劈裂时，每次暴击攻击可生成多个层数。
• 可以在激活期间刷新。

live|psyker|perilous-combustion.desc: Killing an Elite or a Specialist Enemy applies 3 stack(s) of Soulblaze to nearby Enemies, causing Damage over time.
live|psyker|perilous-combustion.advancedEn:
Killing an Elite or a Specialist applies 3 Stacks of Soulblaze to all enemies within a 4-meter radius. Up to 31 Stacks on a target.

• Lasts 8 seconds.
• Ticks every 0.75 seconds.
• Refreshes duration on Stack application.
• Does proc on Elites or Specials killed by Soulblaze, Burn or Bleed ticks.
• Very high armor Damage.
• Very low armor Damage vs Carapace.
live|psyker|perilous-combustion.advancedCn:
击杀精英或专家敌人时，对半径4米内所有敌人施加3层灵魂之火。单一目标最多31层。

• 持续8秒。
• 每0.75秒跳动一次。
• 应用层数时刷新持续时间。
• 若精英或专家死于灵魂之火、燃烧或流血的跳动，也会触发。
• 对护甲造成极高伤害。
• 对甲壳甲伤害极低。

live|psyker|battle-meditation.desc: -10% Peril Generation. 10% chance to Quell 10% Peril on Kill.
live|psyker|battle-meditation.advancedEn:
• 10% Peril Generation.

• 10% chance to Quell 10% Peril on Kill.

• Can be used to prevent the Psyker from exploding.
live|psyker|battle-meditation.advancedCn:
• 反噬产生量降低 10%。

• 10% 机率在击杀时平息 10% 反噬。

• 可用于防止灵能者 自爆。

live|psyker|perfect-timing.desc: +3% Damage for 10 s on Critical Attack. Stacks 5 times.
live|psyker|perfect-timing.advancedEn:
• +3% Damage for 10 seconds on Critical Attack.
• Stacks 5 times.

• Can be refreshed during active duration.
• Generates 1 stack per Critical Attack regardless of how many enemies have been hit.
live|psyker|perfect-timing.advancedCn:
• 暴击攻击时，获得+3%伤害，持续10秒。
• 叠加5次。

• 可以在激活期间刷新。
• 每次暴击攻击产生1层，无论击中多少敌人。

live|psyker|brain-rupture.desc: Charge up your Psychic Power and release it to deal immense Damage to a Single Enemy. This is an augmented version of Brain Burst dealing +50% Damage.
live|psyker|brain-rupture.advancedEn:
Charge up your psychic power and release it to deal immense Damage to a Single Enemy.
• An augmented version of Brain Burst that deals +50% Damage.

• Effective against Flak and Carapace.
• Always targets Weakspots.
• Charging the main attack to 50% lightly Staggers the target.
• On impact, Staggers almost all enemies.
• Cannot Stagger Mutants, Ogryns, Monstrosities or enemies with active Void shield.
• Cannot Crit.
• Warning!
• Casting with 97% Peril or higher will trigger a self-explosion!
live|psyker|brain-rupture.advancedCn:
充能灵能并释放，对单个敌人造成巨额伤害。
• Brain Burst的强化版本，造成+50%伤害。

• 对防弹甲与甲壳甲有效。
• 总是命中弱点。
• 主要攻击充能至50%时轻微踉跄目标。
• 命中时踉跄几乎所有敌人。
• 无法踉跄突变者、欧格林、巨兽或拥有主动虚空护盾的敌人。
• 无法暴击。
• 警告！
在97%或以上危机值时施放会引发自爆！

live|psyker|assail.desc: Throw swift, homing projectiles formed of psychic energy. Less effective versus Carapace Armoured Enemies.
live|psyker|assail.advancedEn:
Primary attack:
• Throw swift, homing projectiles that track the nearest enemy for 2.5 seconds.
• Deals 225 Base Damage to the first target and costs 10% Peril.

Secondary attack:
• Launch a homing projectile that flies for 3 seconds, striking all enemies within a 50-meter radius.
• Deals 380 Base Damage and costs 25% Peril.

• Can Crit.
• Costs 1 ammo.
• Regenerates 1 ammo every 3 seconds.
• Cannot Cleave through Carapace armor by default.

• Warning!
• Do not use at 100% Peril, or you will self-explode.
live|psyker|assail.advancedCn:
主要攻击：
• 投掷快速、自动追踪的投射物，追踪最近的敌人 2.5 秒。
• 对第一个目标造成 225 基础伤害，消耗 10% 危机值。

次要攻击：
• 发射一个自动追踪投射物，飞行 3 秒，击中半径 50 米内的所有敌人。
• 造成 380 基础伤害，消耗 25% 危机值。

• 可以暴击。
• 消耗 1 弹药。
• 每 3 秒恢复 1 弹药。
• 默认情况下无法劈裂甲壳甲。

• 警告！
不要在 100% 危机值 时使用，否则会自爆。

live|psyker|ethereal-shards.desc: Projectiles from Assail now pierce additional targets.
live|psyker|ethereal-shards.descCn: • Assail的投射物现在能穿透额外目标。
live|psyker|ethereal-shards.advancedEn: • Assail projectiles now pierce through additional targets.
live|psyker|ethereal-shards.advancedCn: • Assail的投射物现在能穿透额外目标。

live|psyker|smite.desc: Unleash a torrent of Bio-Lightning - a fast, channelled attack that Locks to and Stuns an Enemy while dealing Damage. This spreads to nearby Enemies. Charge to increase Spread rate and Damage.
live|psyker|smite.advancedEn:
Unleash a torrent of chain bio-lightning that arcs between enemies, dealing low Electrocuting Damage over time and inflicting high Stagger.
The secondary charged attack deals increased Damage and jumps faster.

• Max range: 16 meters.
• Only targets torso hitzone.
• Cannot Crit.• Average armor Damage.
• Low Damage vs Carapace.
• Cannot Stagger Monstrosities or enemies with an active Void shield.

• Forces a brief Quelling action upon reaching 100% Peril, removing ~8.5% Peril. If released below 100% Peril, it pushes enemies back.

• Warning!
• Do not use a Primary attack while channeling a Secondary attack at 100% Peril, or you will self-explode.
live|psyker|smite.advancedCn:
释放在敌人之间跳跃的链式生物闪电，造成低量持续电击伤害，并造成大量踉跄。
次要蓄力攻击造成更高伤害，且跳跃速度更快。

• 最大射程：16 公尺。
• 仅命中躯干部位。
• 无法造成致命一击。• 对护甲造成中等伤害。
• 对甲壳护甲造成低量伤害。
• 无法踉跄 巨兽或有虚空护盾的敌人。

• 反噬达 100% 时会强制短暂平息，消除约 8.5% 反噬。若在低于 100% 反噬时停止施放，则会推开敌人。

• 警告！
• 在 100% 反噬下引导次要攻击时，请勿使用主要攻击，否则将触发自爆！

live|psyker|kinetic-resonance.desc: Using your Combat Ability makes your Brain Rupture charge +75% faster and generate 50% less Peril for 10 s.
live|psyker|kinetic-resonance.advancedEn:
Using your Combat Ability buffs your Brain Rupture for 10 seconds:
• +75% charge speed,
• -50% Peril generation.

• Affects both Primary and Secondary attacks.
live|psyker|kinetic-resonance.advancedCn:
使用作战技能后，在10秒内强化你的Brain Rupture：
• +75% 充能速度，
• -50% 危机值生成。

• 影响主要与次要攻击。

live|psyker|seers-presence.desc: +10% Cooldown Reduction on Abilities for you and Allies in Coherency. This is an augmented version of The Quickening .
live|psyker|seers-presence.descCn:
• 您与连携中的盟友减少+10%冷却。
• The Quickening的强化版本。

• 不会与其他灵能者的相同光环叠加。
live|psyker|seers-presence.advancedEn:
• +10% Cooldown Reduction on Abilities for you and Allies in Coherency.
• An augmented version of The Quickening.

• Does not Stack with the same Aura from another Psyker.
live|psyker|seers-presence.advancedCn:
• 您与连携中的盟友减少+10%冷却。
• The Quickening的强化版本。

• 不会与其他灵能者的相同光环叠加。

live|psyker|venting-shriek.desc: Unleashes a wave of warp energy that Staggers Enemies in front of you. Quells 50% Peril. Base Cooldown: 30 s This is an augmented version of Psykinetic's Wrath .
live|psyker|venting-shriek.advancedEn:
Quells 50% Peril while releasing a cone-shaped shout that Staggers enemies in front of you.
• An augmented version of Psykinetic's Wrath.
• Base Cooldown: 30 seconds.

• Can be used to prevent the Psyker from exploding.
• The Warp wave travels through walls and spreads up to 30 meters, allowing you to Stun a Pox Hound attacking an ally through obstacles.
• Stuns enemies within a 5-meter radius in front of you.
• Always targets Torso hitzone.
live|psyker|venting-shriek.advancedCn:
释放一个锥形呐喊，平息50%危机值，并踉跄前方的敌人。
• Psykinetic's Wrath的强化版本。
• 基础冷却：30秒。

• 可用于防止灵能者自爆。
• 亚空间波可穿墙，传播至多30米，让你穿过障碍物眩晕攻击盟友的瘟疫猎犬。
• 眩晕前方5米半径内的敌人。
• 总是击中躯干区域。

live|psyker|scriers-gaze.desc: Triggers Scrier's Gaze. When entering Scrier's Gaze you Quell 50% Peril as well as gain +10% Damage, +20% Critical Chance, +10% Weakspot Damage, +20% Toughness Damage Reduction, and Suppression Immunity. You also replenish 2.5% Toughness each second. For every second in Scrier's Gaze you gain +1% Damage up to a maximum of +30% . This effect lingers for 10 s after leaving Scrier's Gaze. While in Scrier's Gaze you build up Peril. Build-up is temporarily slowed down by enemy Kills. At 100% Peril, Scrier's Gaze ends. Base Cooldown: 25 s
live|psyker|scriers-gaze.descCn:
进入占卜师的凝视，平息50%危机值并获得：
• +10% 伤害，
• +20% 暴击几率，
• +10% 弱点伤害，
• 每秒 2.5% 韧性，
• +20% 韧性伤害减免，
• 压制免疫。

处于占卜师的凝视时，每秒获得层数：
• +1% 伤害，最高+30%。离开占卜师的凝视后，此效果持续10秒。

处于占卜师的凝视时，你会累积危机值。击杀敌人可暂时减缓累积速度。
达到100%危机值时，能力结束。
• 基础冷却：25秒。
live|psyker|scriers-gaze.advancedEn:
You enter Scrier Gaze, Quell 50% Peril and gain:
• +10% Damage,
• +20% Critical Chance,
• +10% Weakspot Damage,
• 2.5% Toughness per second,
• +20% Toughness Damage Reduction,
• Suppression Immunity.

For every second in Scrier Gaze you gain Stacks:
• +1% Damage, up to +30% This effect lingers for 10 seconds after leaving Scrier Gaze.

While in Scrier Gaze you build up Peril. Build-up is temporarily slowed down by enemy Kills.
At 100% Peril Ability ends.
• Base Cooldown: 25 seconds.
live|psyker|scriers-gaze.advancedCn:
进入占卜师的凝视，平息50%危机值并获得：
• +10% 伤害，
• +20% 暴击几率，
• +10% 弱点伤害，
• 每秒 2.5% 韧性，
• +20% 韧性伤害减免，
• 压制免疫。

处于占卜师的凝视时，每秒获得层数：
• +1% 伤害，最高+30%。离开占卜师的凝视后，此效果持续10秒。

处于占卜师的凝视时，你会累积危机值。击杀敌人可暂时减缓累积速度。
达到100%危机值时，能力结束。
• 基础冷却：25秒。

live|psyker|creeping-flames.desc: Venting Shriek applies 1 - 6 Stack(s) of Soulblaze to targets Hit based on your current Peril.
live|psyker|creeping-flames.advancedEn:
Venting Shriek applies 1 - - 6 Stacks of Soulblaze to targets Hit based on your current Peril.
_______________________________
Soulblaze: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6
Peril (%): 0 | ~17 | ~33 | ~50 | ~67 | ~83
_______________________________
• Lasts 8 seconds.
• Ticks every 0.75 seconds.

• Refreshes duration on Stack application.
• Very high armor Damage.
• Very low armor Damage vs Carapace.

live|psyker|precognition.desc: Weakspot Kills count as 1 s spent in Scrier's Gaze . For each second spent in Scrier's Gaze , you now also gain +1% Finesse Damage ( +30% max) which lingers for 10 s after leaving Scrier's Gaze .
live|psyker|precognition.descCn:
处于Scrier's Gaze超载时，弱点击杀会产生1额外层数。
• 劈裂时，每次攻击可触发多次。

在Scrier's Gaze中每秒还可获得：
• +1% 灵巧伤害，最高+30%，离开Scrier's Gaze后持续10秒。
live|psyker|precognition.advancedEn:
Weakspot kills generate 1 additional Stack while Scrier's Gaze overcharging.
• Can proc multiple times per attack when Cleaving.

For each second spent in Scrier's Gaze, you now also gain:
• +1% Finesse Damage, up to +30% Max, which lingers for 10 seconds after leaving Scrier's Gaze.
live|psyker|precognition.advancedCn:
处于Scrier's Gaze超载时，弱点击杀会产生1额外层数。
• 劈裂时，每次攻击可触发多次。

在Scrier's Gaze中每秒还可获得：
• +1% 灵巧伤害，最高+30%，离开Scrier's Gaze后持续10秒。

live|psyker|warp-speed.desc: Scrier's Gaze now also increases your Movement Speed by +20% while active.
live|psyker|warp-speed.advancedEn:
While Scrier's Gaze overcharging:
• +20% Movement Speed.

• Doesn't linger after overcharging phase.
live|psyker|warp-speed.advancedCn:
Scrier's Gaze超载期间：
• +20% 移动速度。

• 超载阶段结束后不持续。

live|psyker|quick-shards.advancedEn:
• +30% Assail charge replenish speed.

• Reduces projectile recharge time from 3 to 2.1 seconds per projectile.
live|psyker|quick-shards.advancedCn:
• +30% Assail充能恢复速度。

• 将投射物恢复时间从 3 秒减少至每投射物 2.1 秒。

live|psyker|prescience.desc: You and Allies in Coherency gain +5% Critical Hit Chance.
live|psyker|prescience.advancedEn:
• +5% Critical Hit Chance for you and Allies in Coherency.

• Applies to all attacks that can Crit.
• Does not Stack with the same Aura from another Psyker.
live|psyker|prescience.advancedCn:
• 您与连携中的盟友获得+5%暴击命中几率。

• 适用于所有可暴击的攻击。
• 不会与其他灵能者的相同光环叠加。

live|psyker|wildfire.desc: When an Enemy dies while affected by your Soulblaze, nearby Enemies each gain up to 4 Stacks of Soulblaze. They cannot gain more stacks than the dying Enemy had.
live|psyker|wildfire.advancedEn:
When an Enemy dies while affected by your Soulblaze, nearby Enemies each gain up to 4 Stacks of Soulblaze. They cannot gain more Stacks than the dying Enemy had.

• The amount of Soulblaze Stacks that spread depends on the amount of Soulblaze Stacks on the dying enemy:
_______________________________
Stacks: 1| 2| 3| 4| >4
Spreads: 0| 2| 3| 4| 4
_______________________________
• Targets do not receive Soulblaze Stacks caused by the Talent if they already have 4 Stacks or more on them.
• Daemonhosts are not valid targets.
live|psyker|wildfire.advancedCn:
当敌人死于你的灵魂之火时，附近的每个敌人获得最多4层灵魂之火。它们获得的层数不会超过死去敌人原有的层数。

• 传播的灵魂之火层数取决于死去敌人身上的层数：
_______________________________
层数： 1| 2| 3| 4| >4
传播： 0| 2| 3| 4| 4
_______________________________
• 若目标身上已有4层或更多灵魂之火，则不会获得传播的层数。
• 恶魔宿主不是有效目标。

live|psyker|psykinetics-aura.desc: 50% Cooldown Regeneneration for 5 s, when you or an Ally in Coherency kills an Elite or Specialist Enemy.
live|psyker|psykinetics-aura.descCn:
• 当你或连携中的盟友击杀精英或专家敌人时，在5秒内，冷却恢复速度提高50%。

• 可以在激活期间刷新。
live|psyker|psykinetics-aura.advancedEn:
• 50% Cooldown Regeneration for 5 seconds when you or an Ally in Coherency kills an Elite or Specialist enemy.

• Can be refreshed during active duration.
live|psyker|psykinetics-aura.advancedCn:
• 当你或连携中的盟友击杀精英或专家敌人时，在5秒内，冷却恢复速度提高50%。

• 可以在激活期间刷新。

live|psyker|mind-in-motion.desc: Your Movement Speed is not reduced while Quelling Peril or Reloading.
live|psyker|mind-in-motion.advancedEn:
Your Movement Speed is not reduced while Quelling Peril or Reloading.

• Does not interact with movement speed buffs.
live|psyker|mind-in-motion.advancedCn:
平息反噬 或装填时，移动速度不降低。

• 不与移动速度增益互动。

live|psyker|enfeeble.desc: Enemies Electrocuted by you take +10% increased Base Damage from all sources.
live|psyker|enfeeble.advancedEn:
• +10% Damage Taken from all sources for enemies under your Smite's Electrocution.

• Does not Stack with the same debuff from another Psyker.
live|psyker|enfeeble.advancedCn:
• 受到你的Smite电击影响的敌人，承受所有来源的伤害提高+10%。

• 不会与其他灵能者的相同减益效果叠加。

live|psyker|one-with-the-warp.desc: Gain Toughness Damage Reduction of +10% to +33% based on your current Peril.
live|psyker|one-with-the-warp.advancedEn:
• +10% to +33% Toughness Damage Reduction based on your current Peril.

• Always grants a minimum of +10% Toughness Damage Reduction regardless of current Peril amount and scales linearly:
_______________________________
Peril: 0| 20| 40| 50| 60| 80| 100
TDR(%): 10| ~15| ~19| ~22| ~24| ~28| 33
_______________________________

live|psyker|empathic-evasion.desc: A Critical Hit makes you count as Dodging against Ranged Attacks for 1 s.
live|psyker|empathic-evasion.advancedEn:
• A Critical Hit makes you count as Dodging against Ranged Attacks for 1 second.

• Can be refreshed during active duration.
live|psyker|empathic-evasion.advancedCn:
• 暴击命中使你在1秒内视为正在闪避远程攻击。

• 可以在激活期间刷新。

live|psyker|anticipation.desc: Increase Effective Dodges by 1 and time considered Dodging by +50% .
live|psyker|anticipation.advancedEn:
• +1 Effective Dodges.

• +50% Dodge duration.
• Increases from 0.2 to 0.3 seconds.
live|psyker|anticipation.advancedCn:
• +1 有效闪避次数。

• +50% 闪避持续时间。
• 从 0.2 秒提高至 0.3 秒。

live|psyker|solidity.advancedEn:
• +30% Quell Speed.

• Applies only to Active Quelling, Passive Quelling is unaffected.
live|psyker|solidity.advancedCn:
• +30% 镇静速度。

• 仅适用于主动镇静，被动镇静不受影响。

live|psyker|warp-rider.desc: Deal up to +20% Damage (increases as your Peril increases).

live|psyker|true-aim.desc: Landing 5 Weakspot Hits grants your next Ranged Attack a guaranteed Critical. Can only trigger once per Attack.
live|psyker|true-aim.advancedEn:
• Landing 5 Weakspot Hits grants your next Ranged Attack a guaranteed Critical.

• Weakspot Stacks last until consumed.
• Can only trigger once per Attack.
• Shooting air consumes the guaranteed Crit.
live|psyker|true-aim.advancedCn:
• 命中5次弱点后，下一次远程攻击必定暴击。

• 弱点层数持续直到被消耗。
• 每次攻击只能触发一次。
• 对空射击会消耗必定的暴击。

live|psyker|kinetic-deflection.desc: While below critical Peril, Blocking an attack causes you to gain Peril instead of losing Stamina. Gained Peril is 25% of the blocked attacks stamina cost.
live|psyker|kinetic-deflection.advancedEn:
• While below 97% Peril, Blocking an attack causes you to gain Peril instead of losing Stamina.

• Gained Peril is 25% of the blocked attack's Stamina cost.
live|psyker|kinetic-deflection.advancedCn:
• 当危机值低于97%时，格挡攻击会使你获得危机值而非消耗耐力。

• 获得的危机值为被格挡攻击耐力消耗的25%。

live|psyker|enervating-threshold.desc: Telekine Shield has a 20% chance to Electrocute enemies that pass through it. Specialist enemies have a 100% chance to get Electrocuted but also damage the Telekine Shield .
live|psyker|enervating-threshold.advancedEn:
Telekine Shield has a 20% chance to Electrocute enemies that pass through it. Specialists and Monstrosities have a 100% chance to get Electrocuted but also damage the Telekine Shield.

• Deals 250 Base Damage.
• Can Stagger all enemies except Monstrosities and enemies with active Void shield.
• The Electrocution is always applied to Specialists and Monstrosities on contact.
• Very low armor Damage.

• BUG
Specialists and Monstrosities only deal 1 Damage to the shield upon contact, instead of the intended 8.
live|psyker|enervating-threshold.advancedCn:
Telekine Shield有20%几率电击穿过它的敌人。专家和巨兽有100%几率被电击，但也会伤害Telekine Shield。

• 造成250基础伤害。
• 可踉跄除巨兽和拥有主动虚空护盾外的所有敌人。
• 接触时，专家和巨兽必定会受到电击。
• 对护甲伤害极低。

• 错误
专家和巨兽接触时仅对护盾造成1点伤害，而非预期的8点。

live|psyker|sanctuary.desc: Allies inside your Telekine Shield replenish 10% Toughness each second. When your Telekine Shield dissipates, all Allies inside gain +50% Toughness Damage Reduction for 5 s
live|psyker|sanctuary.descCn:
• 你的Telekine Shield内的盟友每秒恢复10%韧性。

• 你的Telekine Shield消散时，内部的盟友获得+50%韧性伤害减免，持续5秒。

• 若多个球体重叠，此效果叠加。
live|psyker|sanctuary.advancedEn:
• 10% Toughness per second replenishes for Allies inside your Telekine Shield.

• +50% Toughness Damage Reduction for 5 seconds for allies inside your Telekine Shield when it dissipates.

• This effects Stack if multiple spheres overlap.
live|psyker|sanctuary.advancedCn:
• 你的Telekine Shield内的盟友每秒恢复10%韧性。

• 你的Telekine Shield消散时，内部的盟友获得+50%韧性伤害减免，持续5秒。

• 若多个球体重叠，此效果叠加。

live|psyker|telekine-dome.desc: Telekine Shield now forms a spherical shield which lasts 25 s, but the Cooldown is increased to 60 s.
live|psyker|telekine-dome.advancedEn:
Telekine Shield now forms a spherical shield.
• Lasts 25 seconds.

• Sphere radius: 6 meters.
• Protects from enemy attacks from all angles.

• Cooldown is increased to 60 seconds.
live|psyker|telekine-dome.advancedCn:
Telekine Shield现在形成一个球形护盾。
• 持续25秒。

• 球体半径：6米。
• 全方位抵御敌人攻击。

• 冷却时间增加至60秒。

live|psyker|bolstered-shield.desc: Telekine Shield now holds up to 2 charges.
live|psyker|bolstered-shield.advancedEn:
• Telekine Shield now holds up to 2 charges.

• The second charge's Cooldown starts once the first one is ready.
live|psyker|bolstered-shield.advancedCn:
• Telekine Shield现在最多可储存2次使用次数。

• 第二次使用次数的冷却在第一次冷却完成后开始计算。

live|psyker|essence-harvest.desc: Replenish 30% Toughness over 5 s on gaining Warp Charge. Gaining a new Warp Charge during this time resets the timer.
live|psyker|essence-harvest.advancedEn:
• 6% Toughness is replenished per second for 5 seconds after gaining Warp Charge, up to 30% Toughness.

• Can be refreshed during active duration.
• Doesn't increase the amount of Toughness replenished.
live|psyker|essence-harvest.advancedCn:
• 获得亚空间充能后，每秒恢复6% 韧性，持续5秒，最多恢复30%韧性。

• 可以在激活期间刷新。• 不增加韧性恢复量。

live|psyker|overpowering-souls.desc: Guaranteed chance to gain Empowered Psionics on Elite Kills.
live|psyker|overpowering-souls.descCn: • 击杀精英敌人时，保证获得Empowered Psionics。
live|psyker|overpowering-souls.advancedEn: • Guaranteed chance to gain Empowered Psionics on Elite Kills.
live|psyker|overpowering-souls.advancedCn: • 击杀精英敌人时，保证获得Empowered Psionics。

live|psyker|perfectionism.desc: Maximum Precision Bonus stacks are increased from 15 to 25 .
live|psyker|perfectionism.advancedEn: • +10 to Maximum Precision Bonus Stacks. Increases from 15 to 25.
live|psyker|perfectionism.advancedCn: • +10 最大精准奖励层数。从15提高至25。

live|psyker|lingering-influence.desc: Increase the duration of Disrupt Destiny from 5 s to 10 s.
live|psyker|lingering-influence.advancedEn: • +5 seconds to the duration of Precision Stacks. Increases from 15 to 10 seconds.
live|psyker|lingering-influence.advancedCn: • +5秒精准层数的持续时间。从15秒提高至10秒。

live|psyker|charged-up.desc: You can now hold up to 3 Stacks of Empowered Psionics .
live|psyker|charged-up.descCn: • 现在最多可储存3层Empowered Psionics。
live|psyker|charged-up.advancedEn: • You can now hold up to 3 Stacks of Empowered Psionics.
live|psyker|charged-up.advancedCn: • 现在最多可储存3层Empowered Psionics。

live|psyker|in-fire-reborn.desc: Killing an Enemy with Soulblaze has a 10% chance to grant you a Warp Charge.
live|psyker|in-fire-reborn.advancedEn:
• 10% chance to gain a Warp Charge when you or an Ally kill an enemy who is currently affected by Soulblaze.

• This effect has no range limit and benefits all Psykers who have this Talent equipped.
live|psyker|in-fire-reborn.advancedCn:
• 当你或盟友杀死正受到灵魂之火影响的敌人时，10%几率获得一个亚空间充能。

• 此效果没有距离限制，并会影响所有装备此天赋的灵能者。

live|psyker|psychic-vampire.desc: Whenever you or an ally in Coherency kill an Enemy, you have a 4% chance to gain a Warp Charge.
live|psyker|psychic-vampire.advancedEn:
• 4% chance to gain a Warp Charge whenever you or an Ally in Coherency kills an enemy.

• This Talent's effect is shared with all allied Psykers in Coherency who also have it.
live|psyker|psychic-vampire.advancedCn:
• 每当您或连携中的盟友杀死敌人时，4%几率获得一个亚空间充能。

• 此天赋的效果会与连携中同样装备此天赋的盟友灵能者共享。

live|psyker|warp-battery.desc: Can store up to 6 Warp Charges.
live|psyker|warp-battery.advancedEn: • +2 Maximum Warp Charges. Increases from 4 to 6.
live|psyker|warp-battery.advancedCn: • +2 最大亚空间充能。从 4 提高至 6。

live|psyker|warp-unbound.desc: Scrier's Gaze now also prevents overloading from Perils of the Warp, during its lingering effect.
live|psyker|warp-unbound.advancedEn:
Scrier's Gaze now also prevents overloading from Perils of the Warp, during its lingering effect.

• After overcharging has ended, allows Psyker to execute Peril-generating actions while at 100% Peril for 10 seconds without triggering the self-explosion.

• When 10 seconds duration ends, Scrier's Gaze base grace period still applies, providing another 1.5 seconds of the same effect.
live|psyker|warp-unbound.advancedCn:
Scrier's Gaze现在在其持续效果期间，也能防止因亚空间危机而超载。

• 超载结束后，允许灵能者在10秒内，即使处于100% 危机值，仍可执行产生危机值的动作而不引发自爆。

• 当10秒结束后，Scrier's Gaze的基础宽限期仍然适用，提供额外1.5秒的相同效果。

live|psyker|warp-splitting.desc: Up to +100% Cleave, based on Peril.
live|psyker|warp-splitting.advancedEn:
• Up to +100% Cleave, based on Peril.

• Carapace armor cannot be Cleaved by default.
live|psyker|warp-splitting.advancedCn:
• 根据当前危机值，最多获得+100%劈裂值。

• 默认情况下，甲壳护甲无法被劈裂。

live|psyker|souldrinker.desc: Killing an Enemy with Soulblaze restores 15% Toughness over 5 s and grants 5% Critical Hit Chance for the duration.
live|psyker|souldrinker.advancedEn:
Killing an enemy with Soulblaze grants the following for 5 seconds:
• +5% Critical Hit Chance,
• 3% Toughness per second, up to 15% Toughness total.

• Can be refreshed during active duration.
• This Talent's effects have no range limit and can be procced at any distance to the dying enemy.
live|psyker|souldrinker.advancedCn:
以灵魂之火击杀敌人时，在5秒内获得以下效果：
• +5% 暴击命中几率，
• 每秒恢复3% 韧性，总共最多恢复15%韧性。

• 可以在激活期间刷新。
• 此天赋的效果没有距离限制，可在任何距离触发。

live|psyker|by-crack-of-bone.desc: Melee Weakspot Kills Quell 10% Peril and Reduce further Peril Generation by 20% for 4 s.
live|psyker|by-crack-of-bone.advancedEn:
• 10% Peril Quelled on Melee Weakspot kills.
• Can proc multiple times per swing when Cleaving.
• -20% Peril Generation for 4 seconds on Melee Weakspot kills.
• Can be refreshed during active duration.
live|psyker|by-crack-of-bone.advancedCn:
• 近战弱点击杀时，平息10%危机值。
• 当劈裂时，每次挥击可以触发多次。
• 近战弱点击杀时，危机值生成减少-20%，持续4秒。
• 可以在激活期间刷新。

live|psyker|empyric-resolve.advancedEn:
• -40% Peril Generation.

• -30% Toughness Replenished.
• Does not interact with Coherency Toughness Regeneration. Only affects Melee kills and Talents.
live|psyker|empyric-resolve.advancedCn:
• -40% 危机值生成。

• -30% 韧性恢复。
• 不与协同韧性互动。 仅影响近战击杀和天赋。

live|psyker|tranquility-through-slaughte.desc: Non-Warp Ranged Critical Hits Quell 4% Peril.
live|psyker|tranquility-through-slaughte.advancedEn:
• 4% Peril is quelled on Non-Warp Ranged Critical Hits.

• Procs when hitting Shields.
• Procs only Once per shot regardless of how many enemies have been hit.
live|psyker|tranquility-through-slaughte.advancedCn:
• 非亚空间远程暴击命中时，平息4%危机值。

• 命中护盾时触发。
• 每次射击仅触发一次，无论击中多少敌人。

live|psyker|charged-strike.desc: Your Heavy Melee Attacks electrocute enemies hit, damaging them.
live|psyker|charged-strike.advancedEn:
Your Heavy Melee Attacks Electrocute enemies, damaging them over time.

• Deals up to 64 base Damage per tick at max charge.
• The Damage window lasts up to 2 seconds.
• The Electrocuted state persists for 2 seconds after the last Damage tick.

• With Enfeeble selected, Electrocution deals Damage twice as long and reaches max charge faster.
live|psyker|charged-strike.advancedCn:
你的近战重击会电击敌人，随时间造成伤害。

• 最大充能时每次跳动最多造成 64 基础伤害.
• 伤害窗口持续最多 2 秒。
• 最后一次伤害跳动后，电击状态持续 2 秒。

• 选择削弱时，电击的持续时间加倍，且更快达到最大充能。

live|psyker|crystalline-will.desc: +100% Overload Explosion Damage and +25% Overload Explosion Radius. Overloading through Perils of the Warp no longer knocks you down, but you still take the appropriate Corruption Damage. If the explosion kills an Elite enemy, you don't take any Corruption Damage.
live|psyker|crystalline-will.advancedEn:
• +100% Overload Explosion Damage,
• +25% Overload Explosion Radius.

• Base Damage: [600-100].

• Overloading through Perils of the Warp no longer knocks you down, but you lose 1 Health segment from Corruption Damage.
• If the explosion kills an Elite enemy, you don't take any Corruption Damage.
live|psyker|crystalline-will.advancedCn:
• 超载爆炸伤害提高+100%，
• 超载爆炸半径提高+25%。

• 基础伤害：[600-100]。

• 因亚空间危机超载不再击倒你，但会使你损失1格生命值，转化为腐化伤害。
• 若爆炸击杀精英敌人，则不会受到腐化伤害。

live|psyker|channeled-force.desc: +20% Damage to Force Staff's Primary Attacks after Fully Charged Force Staff Secondary Attacks. Lasts 5 s. +10% Damage to Force Staff's Secondary Attacks after Force Staff Primary Attack. Lasts 5 s.
live|psyker|channeled-force.advancedEn:
• +20% Damage to Force Staff's Primary Attacks after Fully Charged Force Staff Secondary Attacks.
• Lasts 5 seconds.

• +10% Damage to Force Staff's Secondary Attacks after Force Staff Primary Attack.
• Lasts 5 seconds.

• Can be refreshed during active duration.
• For Inferno Staff, both of this Talent's buffs only increase the Damage of the flame direct hit, Soulblaze damage is unaffected.
live|psyker|channeled-force.advancedCn:
• 完全充能的次要攻击后，下一次灵能杖的主要攻击获得+20%伤害。
• 持续5秒。

• 主要攻击后，灵能杖的次要攻击获得+10%伤害。
• 持续5秒。

• 可以在激活期间刷新。
• 对炼狱杖而言，此天赋的两种增益仅增加火焰直接命中的伤害，灵魂之火伤害不受影响。

live|psyker|empyric-shock.desc: 6% Warp-Damage Taken by victims of your Force Staff's Primary Attack. Max Stacks 5 . Lasts 10 s.
live|psyker|empyric-shock.advancedEn:
• 6% Warp-Damage Taken by victims of your Force Staff's Primary Attack.
• Maximum 5 Stacks.
• Lasts 10 seconds.

• Can be refreshed during active duration.
• Can be applied through shields.
live|psyker|empyric-shock.advancedCn:
• 被你的灵能杖主要攻击击中的目标，受到的亚空间伤害提高6%。
• 最多5层。
• 持续10秒。

• 可以在激活期间刷新。
• 可以穿过护盾应用。

live|psyker|warp-rupture-2.desc: Venting Shriek decreases the Damage Dealt by enemies hit by 10% and increases their Damage Taken by 10% for 8 s.
live|psyker|warp-rupture-2.advancedEn:
Venting Shriek applies a debuff to Enemies for 8 seconds:
• -10% Damage Dealt,
• +10% Damage Taken.

• Does not Stack with the same debuff from another Psyker.
live|psyker|warp-rupture-2.advancedCn:
Venting Shriek对敌人施加一个减益效果，持续8秒：
• -10% 造成的伤害，
• +10% 受到的伤害。

• 不会与其他灵能者的相同减益效果叠加。

live|psyker|just-a-dream.desc: While below Critical Peril, 25% of Damage Taken is converted into Peril.
live|psyker|just-a-dream.advancedEn: • 25% of Damage Taken is converted into Peril, while below 97% Peril.
live|psyker|just-a-dream.advancedCn: • 在危机值低于97%时，受到的25%伤害转化为危机值。

live|psyker|immaterial-focus.desc: +10% Damage Resistance, in addition, while at Critical Peril, and for 4 s afterwards, you are Stun Immune.
live|psyker|immaterial-focus.advancedEn:
• +10% Damage Resistance.

While at or above 97% Peril and for 4 seconds after dropping below 97% Peril, grants Immunity to Stuns from both Melee and Ranged Attacks.
• Can be refreshed during active duration.
live|psyker|immaterial-focus.advancedCn:
• +10% 伤害抗性。

在反噬达 97% 或以上时，以及降至 97% 以下后的 4 秒内，
免疫近战和远程攻击的眩晕。
• 可于启用期间刷新。

live|psyker|vulnerable-minds.descCn: • 对欧格林和巨兽造成的伤害提高+20%。
live|psyker|vulnerable-minds.advancedCn: • 对欧格林和巨兽造成的伤害提高+20%。

live|psyker|warp-ghost.desc: -80% Passive Quelling, +2 Stamina, and +25% Toughness Replenishment.
live|psyker|warp-ghost.advancedEn:
• -80% Passive quelling.

• +2 Stamina.

• +25% Toughness Replenishment.
• Does not interact with Coherency Toughness Regeneration. Only affects Melee kills and Talents.
live|psyker|warp-ghost.advancedCn:
• -80% 被动压制。

• +2 耐力。

• +25% 韧性恢复。
• 不与协同韧性互动。 仅影响近战击杀和天赋。

live|ogryn|steady-grip.desc: +12.5% Toughness Regeneration while bracing or shooting your Ranged weapon.
live|ogryn|steady-grip.advancedEn:
While shooting or bracing your Ranged weapon, you gain:
• +12.5% Toughness Regeneration.

• Does not interact with Coherency Toughness Regeneration.
live|ogryn|steady-grip.advancedCn:
射击或瞄准时，获得：
• +12.5% 韧性恢复。

• 不与协同韧性互动。

live|ogryn|heavyweight.desc: +30% Damage against Bulwarks, Crushers, Plague Ogryns and Reapers. Also receive +30% Damage Reduction against the same.
live|ogryn|heavyweight.descCn:
• +30% 对堡垒、粉碎者、瘟疫行者、
瘟疫欧格林和收割者的伤害。

• +30% 受到上述敌人的伤害减少。
live|ogryn|heavyweight.advancedEn:
• +30% Damage against Bulwarks, Crushers, Pack Master, Plague Ogryns and Reapers.

• +30% Damage Reduction against the same.
live|ogryn|heavyweight.advancedCn:
• +30% 对堡垒、粉碎者、瘟疫行者、
瘟疫欧格林和收割者的伤害。

• +30% 受到上述敌人的伤害减少。

live|ogryn|reloaded-and-ready.desc: +15% Ranged Damage for 8 s on reload.
live|ogryn|reloaded-and-ready.descCn:
• 装填后 8 秒内，
+15% 远程伤害。
live|ogryn|reloaded-and-ready.advancedEn: • +15% Ranged Damage for 8 seconds on Reload.
live|ogryn|reloaded-and-ready.advancedCn:
• 装填后 8 秒内，
+15% 远程伤害。

live|ogryn|bonebreakers-aura.desc: +10% Melee Attack Damage for you and Allies in Coherency. This is an augmented version of Intimidating Presence .
live|ogryn|bonebreakers-aura.advancedEn:
• +10% Melee Attack Damage for you and Allies in Coherency.
• This is an augmented version of Intimidating Presence.

• This also buffs the Melee Special actions of Ripper Guns, Grenadier Gauntlet (melee part), Rumbler, Twin-Linked Stubbers, and Kickback.

• Does not Stack with the same Aura from another Ogryn.
live|ogryn|bonebreakers-aura.advancedCn:
• +10% 近战攻击伤害，
对你与协同范围内的队友生效。
• 此为 Intimidating Presence 的强化版本。

• 同样增强以下武器的近战特殊动作：
撕裂者步枪、掷弹兵臂铠（近战部分）、
镇暴枪、双联重型机炮和反冲枪。

• 不会与其他欧格林的相同光环叠加。

live|ogryn|slam.desc: +25% Impact bonus on Melee Attacks. Staggering an enemy with a Melee Attack replenishes 5% Stamina. 0.75 s Cooldown.
live|ogryn|slam.descCn:
• +25% 近战攻击的冲击加成。

• 近战攻击使敌人踉跄 后，恢复 5% 耐力。

• 冷却：0.75 秒。
live|ogryn|slam.advancedEn:
• +25% Impact bonus on Melee Attacks.

• 5% Stamina replenished on Staggering an enemy with a Melee Attack.

• Cooldown: 0.75 second.
live|ogryn|slam.advancedCn:
• +25% 近战攻击的冲击加成。

• 近战攻击使敌人踉跄 后，恢复 5% 耐力。

• 冷却：0.75 秒。

live|ogryn|bombs-away.desc: Throw a box of grenades with great strength and enthusiasm to deal high Damage to a Single Enemy. Hitting an Enemy causes the box to break open, releasing 6 grenades around the target. This is an augmented version of Big Box of Hurt .
live|ogryn|bombs-away.advancedEn:
Throw a box of Grenades with great strength and enthusiasm to deal High Damage to a Single Enemy.
Hitting an Enemy causes the box to break open, releasing 6 grenades around the target.
• This is an augmented version of Big Box of Hurt.

• Impact base Damage: 1850.

Melee Hits grants you a Stacks of Adrenaline.

• Stacks 30 times.
• Stacks last 2 seconds and are dropped one by one.
• Can proc multiple times per swing when Cleaving.
Critical Melee Hits grants:
• +1 additional Stack.

At Max Stacks, remove All Stacks of Adrenaline and gain Adrenaline Frenzy for 10 seconds.

Adrenaline Frenzy grants:
• +25% Melee Damage and
• +10% Attack Speed.
live|hivescum|adrenaline-frenzy.advancedCn:
近战命中获得肾上腺素 层数。最多 30 层，持续 2 秒，逐一衰减。

暴击 近战命中额外 +1 层。

满层时，消耗所有肾上腺素 层数，获得 Adrenaline Frenzy 10 秒。
Adrenaline Frenzy 提供：
• +25% 近战伤害 和
• +10% 攻击速度。

live|hivescum|vultures-mark.desc: Killing a Special or Elite enemy with a ranged weapon grants you a stack of Vulture's Mark for 8 s (Stacks 3 times). Each stack grants +5% Ranged Damage, +5% Ranged Critical Strike Chance, and +5% Movement Speed. While at max stacks, Special and Elite Ranged Kills restore 15% Toughness to you and Allies in Coherency.
live|hivescum|vultures-mark.descCn:
远程武器击杀专家或精英敌人时获得一层秃鹫标记。
• 持续 8 秒。最多 3 层。
• 可以在激活期间刷新。

每层获得：
• +5% 远程伤害，
• +5% 移动速度，
• +5% 远程暴击几率。

满层时，远程击杀专家或精英敌人恢复你和协同 盟友：
• 15% 韧性。
live|hivescum|vultures-mark.advancedEn:
Killing Special or Elite enemy with a Ranged weapon grants you a Stacks of Vulture's Mark.

• Lasts 8 seconds.
• Stacks 3 times.
• Can be refreshed during active duration.

Per Stack you gain:
• +5% Ranged Damage,
• +5% Movement Speed, and
• +5% Ranged Critical Strike Chance.

While at Max Stacks, Special and Elite Ranged Kills restore to you and Allies in Coherency:
• 15% Toughness.
live|hivescum|vultures-mark.advancedCn:
远程武器击杀专家或精英敌人时获得一层秃鹫标记。
• 持续 8 秒。最多 3 层。
• 可以在激活期间刷新。

每层获得：
• +5% 远程伤害，
• +5% 移动速度，
• +5% 远程暴击几率。

满层时，远程击杀专家或精英敌人恢复你和协同 盟友：
• 15% 韧性。

live|hivescum|stimm-supply.desc: Deploy a refitted Medi-Pack on the ground, bolstering you and your allies for 20 s. Operatives breathing the Pack’s gas heal up to 40 Corruption over time and become immune to it. Additionally, if you have a Stimm equipped, Stimm Supply will copy its contents and disperse them into the air, granting its effects to any nearby allies. Base Cooldown: 60 s.
live|hivescum|stimm-supply.advancedEn:
Deploy a refitted Medi-Pack on the ground, bolstering you and your Allies for 20 seconds.

• Radius: 3 meters.

Operatives breathing the Pack's gas heal Corruption over time and become immune to it.
• Removes 0.5 Corruption Damage every 0.25 seconds for all Allies in range. Up to 40.
• Heals Corruption Damage up to the next Health segment.

Additionally, if you have a Stimm equipped, Stimm Supply will copy its contents and disperse them into the air, granting its effects to any nearby Allies.

• Base Cooldown: 60 seconds.
• While the Stimm Supply is active, cooldown is paused and cannot be reduced.
live|hivescum|stimm-supply.advancedCn:
在地面放置改装医疗包，加强你和盟友 20 秒。半径 3 米。

吸入气体的成员治愈腐化 并获得免疫。
• 每 0.25 秒移除 0.5 腐化伤害，最多 40。
• 治愈腐化伤害 至下一个生命值 分段。

若装备了兴奋剂，Stimm Supply 会复制其内容并散布到空气中，赋予附近盟友效果。

• 基础冷却：60 秒。
• Stimm Supply 启用期间暂停冷却且不可缩短。

live|hivescum|rampage.desc: Replenish all Toughness and enter Rampage! for 10 s. For the duration, gain +50% Melee Power, +20% Melee Attack Speed and +25% Damage Reduction, as well as becoming Stun and Suppression immune. Melee Strikes extend the duration by 0.3 s. After 20 s, the duration extension granted by each hit is reduced. Base Cooldown: 30 s.
live|hivescum|rampage.advancedEn:
Replenish all Toughness and enter Rampage! for 10 seconds.

For the duration, gain:
• +50% Melee Strength,
• +20% Melee Attack Speed,
• +25% Damage Reduction,
• Stun Immunity and
• Slowdown Immunity.

Duration Extension on Melee Strike:
• First 20 seconds: +0.3 seconds per hit.
• After 20 seconds: +0.15 seconds per hit.
• Effect diminishes further every 20 seconds.
• Can proc multiple times when Cleaving.
• Base Cooldown: 30 seconds.
• Cooldown paused while Rampage! active.
live|hivescum|rampage.advancedCn:
补满所有韧性并进入 Rampage!，持续 10 秒。

期间获得：
• +50% 近战威力，
• +20% 近战攻击速度，
• +25% 伤害减免，
• 免疫眩晕，并
• 免疫缓速。

近战命中延长持续时间：
• 前 20 秒：每次命中 +0.3 秒。
• 超过 20 秒后：每次命中 +0.15 秒。
• 效果每 20 秒进一步衰减。
• 顺劈攻击时可触发多次。
• 基础冷却：30 秒。
• Rampage! 启用期间将暂停冷却。

live|hivescum|cheap-shots.desc: +10% Damage against Enemies that are Staggered. Medium and Heavy Staggered Enemies instead take +15% .
live|hivescum|cheap-shots.advancedEn:
• +10% Strength against Staggered Enemies.

• +15% Strength against Medium and Heavy Staggered Enemies.
live|hivescum|cheap-shots.advancedCn:
• 对眩晕敌人造成 +10% 威力。

• 对中度与重度眩晕敌人造成 +15% 威力。

live|hivescum|calling-for-a-time-out.desc: -25% Toughness Damage taken while reloading, and for 4 s afterwards.
live|hivescum|calling-for-a-time-out.advancedEn:
While Reloading and for 4 seconds after a Reload is finished, grants:
• +-25% Toughness Damage Reduction.
live|hivescum|calling-for-a-time-out.advancedCn:
装填期间与装填完成后 4 秒，获得：
• +-25% 韧性伤害减免。

live|hivescum|tis-but-a-scratch.desc: Replenish 30% Toughness over 3 s after taking Ranged Toughness Damage. Losing all Toughness cancels the effect.
live|hivescum|tis-but-a-scratch.advancedEn:
Taking a Ranged Toughness Damage, while Toughness is above 0, replenishes:
• 10% Toughness per second for 3 seconds, up to 30%

• Losing all Toughness cancels the effect.

• Can be refreshed during active duration.
live|hivescum|tis-but-a-scratch.advancedCn:
在韧性高于 0 时，受到远程韧性伤害会恢复：
• 每秒 10% 韧性，持续 3 秒，最高 30%。

• 失去所有韧性会取消此效果。

• 可以在激活期间刷新。

live|hivescum|hive-city-brawler.desc: Up to 20% Damage Reduction, depending on available Stamina. Additionally, up to 20% Melee Damage depending on spent Stamina.
live|hivescum|hive-city-brawler.descCn:
• 依消耗的体力，最高获得 +20% 近战伤害。

• 依可用的耐力，最高获得 +20% 伤害减免。
live|hivescum|hive-city-brawler.advancedEn:
• Up to +20% Melee Damage depending on spent Stamina.

• Up to +20% Damage Reduction, depending on available Stamina.
live|hivescum|hive-city-brawler.advancedCn:
• 依消耗的体力，最高获得 +20% 近战伤害。

• 依可用的耐力，最高获得 +20% 伤害减免。

live|hivescum|battering-strikes.desc: Melee Kills grant +10% Melee Cleave for 5 s. Stacks 5 times.
live|hivescum|battering-strikes.advancedEn:
Melee Kills grant for 5 seconds, per Stack:
• +10% Melee Cleave.

• Stacks 5 times.
• Up to +50% Melee Cleave.

• Can proc multiple times per swing when Cleaving.
live|hivescum|battering-strikes.advancedCn:
近战击杀会使每层提供 5 秒：
• +10% 近战顺劈攻击。

• 可叠加 5 层。
• 最高 +50% 近战顺劈攻击。

• 当劈裂时，每次挥击可以触发多次。

live|hivescum|battering-momentum.desc: Hitting 3 or more Enemies with a single Melee Attack grants +50% Cleave for your next attack.
live|hivescum|battering-momentum.descCn:
单次近战攻击命中 3 个以上敌人时，
获得：
• 下次近战攻击 +50% 顺劈攻击。
live|hivescum|battering-momentum.advancedEn:
Hitting 3 or more Enemies with a single Melee Attack grants:
• +50% Cleave for your next Melee Attack.
live|hivescum|battering-momentum.advancedCn:
单次近战攻击命中 3 个以上敌人时，
获得：
• 下次近战攻击 +50% 顺劈攻击。

live|hivescum|hyper-violence.desc: Kills grants +25% of the difference between the Damage dealt by your attack and the Health of the killed Enemy as Melee Damage for 1 s.
live|hivescum|hyper-violence.advancedEn:
On Kill gain a 1-second Buff that adds flat Damage to your next Melee Attack.

Flat Damage buff equal to:
• +25% of your Overkill Damage.

• [Overkill Damage] = [Damage Dealt] - [Enemy's remaining Health].

• The Buff's duration refreshes only if your new Overkill Damage is greater than the previous one.
live|hivescum|hyper-violence.advancedCn:
击杀时获得 1 秒增益，
使下次近战攻击附加固定伤害。

固定伤害等于：
• 你过量伤害的 +25%。

• [过量伤害] = [造成的伤害] - [敌人剩余生命值]。

• 只有新的过量伤害高于前一次时，
才会刷新增益持续时间。

live|hivescum|toxin-mania.desc: +5% Base Damage for each Chem Toxin infected enemy nearby. Up to +15% .
live|hivescum|toxin-mania.advancedEn:
• +5% base Damage for each Chem Toxin-infected enemy within 12.5 meters.

• Stacks 3 times.
• Up to +15% Damage.
live|hivescum|toxin-mania.advancedCn:
• 12.5 米内每有一名感染化学毒素的敌人，
获得 +5% 基础伤害。

• 可叠加 3 次。
• 最高 +15% 伤害。

live|hivescum|sample-collector.desc: Kills replenish 1% of your Cartel Special Cooldown. Killing Chem Toxin infected Enemies instead replenishes 2% .
live|hivescum|sample-collector.advancedEn:
Killing an enemy with any Attack reduces the remaining Cooldown of Cartel Special Stimm.

Reduction amount per kill:
• Any attack: -1%
• Chem Toxin tick: -2%

• Can proc multiple times per swing when Cleaving.
live|hivescum|sample-collector.advancedCn:
以任何攻击击杀敌人时，缩短卡特尔特制兴奋剂剩余冷却。

每次击杀的缩短量：
• 任意攻击： -1%。
• 化学毒素跳动伤害： -2%。

• 当劈裂时，每次挥击可以触发多次。

live|hivescum|coated-weaponry.desc: Melee Critical Strikes infect Enemies with 1 stack(s) of Chem Toxin .
live|hivescum|coated-weaponry.advancedEn:
• 1 Stack of Chem Toxin applied to enemies by Melee Critical Strikes.

• Can be applied through Bulwark shield.
live|hivescum|coated-weaponry.advancedCn: • 近战暴击攻击会对敌人施加 1 层化学毒素。

live|hivescum|targeted-toxin.desc: Enemies you infect with Chem Toxin deal -15% Damage. Monstrosities instead deal -30% .
live|hivescum|targeted-toxin.descCn:
你感染化学毒素的敌人造成：
• -15% 伤害。

巨兽造成：
• -30% 伤害。
live|hivescum|targeted-toxin.advancedEn:
Enemies you infect with Chem Toxin deal:
• -15% Damage.

Monstrosities deal:
• -30% Damage.
live|hivescum|targeted-toxin.advancedCn:
你感染化学毒素的敌人造成：
• -15% 伤害。

巨兽造成：
• -30% 伤害。

live|hivescum|ammo-jack.descCn:
• +15% 弹匣容量。
• 无条件进位。
live|hivescum|ammo-jack.advancedCn:
• +15% 弹匣容量。
• 无条件进位。

live|hivescum|hyper-critical.desc: Critical Strikes instantly kill Human Sized Enemies if their current Health is less than 2 times the amount of Damage of the Critical Strike.
live|hivescum|hyper-critical.advancedEn:
Critical Melee Attacks instantly kill Human Sized Enemies if their current Health is less than 2 times the amount of Damage of the Critical Strikes.

• [Crit Damage] x 2] > [Health]

• Breeds that are NOT considered 'human-sized': Beast of Nurgle, Bulwark, Captains/Twins, Chaos Spawn, Crusher, Daemonhost, Pack Master, Plague Ogryn, Reaper.
live|hivescum|hyper-critical.advancedCn:
暴击攻击会立即杀死人类体型敌人，
前提是敌人当前生命值低于该次暴击攻击的伤害 x 2。

• [暴击伤害 x 2] > [生命值]

• 不视为「人类体型」的敌人：
• 纳垢巨兽、堡垒、队长/双子、
• 混沌魔物、粉碎者、恶魔宿主、
• 兽群领主、瘟疫欧格林、收割者。

live|hivescum|punching-above-ones-weight.advancedEn:
• +15% Damage against Elites and Monstrosities.

• Breeds with Elite or Monster tag: Beast of Nurgle, Bulwark, Chaos Spawn, Crusher, Daemonhost, Gunners, Mauler, Pack Master, Plague Ogryn, Plasma Gunner, Radio Operator, Ragers, Reaper, Shotgunners.
live|hivescum|punching-above-ones-weight.advancedCn:
• 对精英与巨兽造成 +15% 伤害。

• 具有精英或巨兽标签的品种：纳垢巨兽、堡垒、混沌魔物、粉碎者、恶魔宿主、枪手、大锤、兽群领主、瘟疫欧格林、等离子枪手、通讯兵、狂怒者、收割者、霰弹兵。

live|hivescum|chem-enhanced.desc: Each stack of Dependency additionally grants +5% Critical Hit Chance.
live|hivescum|chem-enhanced.advancedEn: • +5% Critical Hit Chance per Stack of Dependency.
live|hivescum|chem-enhanced.advancedCn: • 每层 Dependency +5% 暴击命中几率。

live|hivescum|vultures-push.desc: Killing Elite or Special enemies with Ranged Attacks knocks all enemies around you backwards.
live|hivescum|vultures-push.advancedEn:
Killing Elite or Special enemies with Ranged Attacks creates a non-damaging explosion that Staggers barely anything at your location.

• Radius 3 meters.
live|hivescum|vultures-push.advancedCn: 远程击杀精英或专家时，在你所在位置中心 3 米内产生无伤害的爆炸，眩晕 附近敌人。

live|hivescum|patient-hunter.desc: Duration of Vulture's Mark is extended to 12 s.
live|hivescum|patient-hunter.advancedEn: • Increases duration of Vulture's Mark from 8 to 12 seconds.
live|hivescum|patient-hunter.advancedCn: • 秃鹫标记 持续时间从 8 秒增加至 12 秒。

live|hivescum|long-lasting.advancedEn:
• +5 seconds to base duration of Celerity Stimm, Combat Stimm, Concentration Stimm, and Cartel Special Stimm. Increases from 15 to 20 seconds.

• Only increases the duration of Stimms that are applied to you.

• Does not increase the 8 seconds duration of Med Stimm.
live|hivescum|long-lasting.advancedCn:
• 敏捷兴奋剂、战斗兴奋剂、专注兴奋剂与卡特尔特制兴奋剂的基础持续时间增加 +5 秒。
• 从 15 秒提高至 20 秒。

• 只会提高套用在你身上的兴奋剂持续时间。

• 不会提高医疗兴奋剂的 8 秒持续时间。

live|hivescum|blessed-stimms.desc: While Stimmed, Kills clear 1% Corruption (up to 50% per Stimm).
live|hivescum|blessed-stimms.advancedEn:
While Stimmed, Kills clear:
• 1% Corruption.

• Heals 50% Corruption Damage up to the next Health segment.

• Can proc multiple times per swing when Cleaving.
live|hivescum|blessed-stimms.advancedCn:
受兴奋剂影响时，击杀会清除：
• 1% 腐化。

• 治疗 50% 腐化伤害，直到下一个生命值分段。

• 当劈裂时，每次挥击可以触发多次。

live|hivescum|burst-of-energy.desc: Gain Stun Immunity for 6 s and restore +50% Toughness when Toughness is broken. 10 s Cooldown.
live|hivescum|burst-of-energy.descCn:
韧性被击破时，获得：
• +50% 韧性，并
• 6 秒眩晕免疫。

• 冷却：10 秒。
live|hivescum|burst-of-energy.advancedEn:
When Toughness is broken you gain:
• +50% Toughness and
• Stun Immunity for 6 seconds.

• Cooldown: 10 seconds.
live|hivescum|burst-of-energy.advancedCn:
韧性被击破时，获得：
• +50% 韧性，并
• 6 秒眩晕免疫。

• 冷却：10 秒。

live|hivescum|adrenaline-assassin.desc: Weakspot Hits now grants +2 additional stack of Adrenaline . Regular Melee Hits grants none.
live|hivescum|adrenaline-assassin.advancedEn:
Weakspot Hits now grants:
• +2 additional Stacks of Adrenaline. Increases from 1 to 3 Stacks.

• Regular Melee Hits grants none.

• Non-Weakspot Melee hits that are Critical still generate +2 Stacks.
live|hivescum|adrenaline-assassin.advancedCn:
弱点 命中现在给予 +2 额外肾上腺素 层，从 1 增至 3 层。
• 普通近战命中不给予。
• 非弱点却暴击的近战命中，仍给予 +2 层。

live|hivescum|stoked-rage.desc: Increase the duration of Adrenaline Frenzy to 20 s.
live|hivescum|stoked-rage.advancedEn: • Increases duration of Adrenaline Frenzy from 10 to 20 seconds.
live|hivescum|stoked-rage.advancedCn: • Adrenaline Frenzy 持续时间从 10 秒增加至 20 秒。

live|hivescum|adrenaline-unbound.desc: While Adrenaline Frenzy is active, you replenish 5% Toughness each second.
live|hivescum|adrenaline-unbound.descCn: Adrenaline Frenzy 启用期间，5% 韧性 /秒恢复。
live|hivescum|adrenaline-unbound.advancedEn:
While Adrenaline Frenzy is active, you replenish:
• 5% Toughness per second.
live|hivescum|adrenaline-unbound.advancedCn: Adrenaline Frenzy 启用期间，5% 韧性 /秒恢复。

live|hivescum|uncontrolled-aggression.desc: Increase the duration of Adrenaline to 4 s.
live|hivescum|uncontrolled-aggression.advancedEn: • Increases duration of Adrenaline from 2 to 4 seconds.
live|hivescum|uncontrolled-aggression.advancedCn: • 肾上腺素 持续时间从 2 秒增加至 4 秒。

live|hivescum|pulverising-strikes.desc: +50% Cleave while Rampage! is active. Additionally, gain +2.5% Melee Power for every second spent with the ability active, up to 10 times.
live|hivescum|pulverising-strikes.advancedEn:
While Rampage! is active:
• +50% Cleave.

Every second while Rampage! is active grants Stacks, up to 10.

Per stack, you gain:
• +2.5% Melee Strength, up to +25%
live|hivescum|pulverising-strikes.advancedCn:
Rampage! 启用期间：
• +50% 顺劈攻击。

每秒增加一层，最多 10 层。每层获得：
• +2.5% 近战威力，最多 +25%。

live|hivescum|channelled-aggression.desc: Heavy Attacks while Rampage! is active have +25% Rending.
live|hivescum|channelled-aggression.descCn:
Rampage! 启用期间，重击获得：
• +25% 撕裂。
live|hivescum|channelled-aggression.advancedEn:
While Rampage! is active Heavy Attacks gain:
• +25% Rending.
live|hivescum|channelled-aggression.advancedCn:
Rampage! 启用期间，重击获得：
• +25% 撕裂。

live|hivescum|boiling-blood.desc: Melee Strikes against Elites and Monstrosities extend the duration of Rampage! by 1 s. Additionally, the time before extending becomes diminished is now 30 s.
live|hivescum|boiling-blood.advancedEn:
• Melee Strikes against Elites, Specials, Monstrosities extend the duration of Rampage! from 0.3 to 1 second.

• Additionally, the time before extending becomes diminished is now 30 seconds.
live|hivescum|boiling-blood.advancedCn:
• 近战命中精英、专家或巨兽时，Rampage! 延长从 0.3 延长至 1 秒。

• 效果衰减时间增加至 30 秒。

live|hivescum|pickpocket.desc: Killing an Elite or Specialist Enemy with a Melee Attack while Ammo Reserve is below 20% will refill it to 20% .
live|hivescum|pickpocket.descCn:
目前备用弹药低于 20% 时，
以近战攻击击杀精英或专家敌人会将备用弹药设为：
• 最大弹药的 20%。
live|hivescum|pickpocket.advancedEn:
While current Ammo in reserve is below 20%, killing an Elite or Specialist Enemy with Melee Attack sets the Ammo count in reserve to:
• 20% of Max Ammo.
live|hivescum|pickpocket.advancedCn:
目前备用弹药低于 20% 时，
以近战攻击击杀精英或专家敌人会将备用弹药设为：
• 最大弹药的 20%。

live|hivescum|focused-resolve.desc: Killing highlighted Enemies restores 0.5 s Ability Cooldown. Elite and Specialist kills instead restore 1 s. 5 s Max Cooldown restored.
live|hivescum|focused-resolve.advancedEn:
Killing a highlighted enemy restores Ability Cooldown:
• Regular enemy: 0.5 seconds.
• Elite or Specialist: 1 second.

• Maximum: 5 seconds.

• Can proc multiple times when Cleaving.
live|hivescum|focused-resolve.advancedCn:
击杀高亮敌人恢复技能冷却：
• 普通敌人：0.5 秒。
• 精英或专家：1 秒。

• 最多 5 秒。

• 当劈裂时，每次挥击可以触发多次。

live|hivescum|pick-your-targets.desc: Gain +15% Rending for your Ranged Attacks while Enhanced Desperado is active. Additionally, killing highlighted enemies also grants +3% Ranged Damage, stacking 5 times.
live|hivescum|pick-your-targets.advancedEn:
While Enhanced Desperado is active, you gain:
• +15% Ranged Rending.

Additionally, killing highlighted enemies also grants Stacks.
• Stacks 5 times.
